metrics.name: landing_ke_ftlbf
metrics.notes: Presentation result rounds terminal-velocity kinetic energy to whole foot-pounds-force.

source.title: NASA Glenn terminal velocity reference
source.citation: Terminal-velocity drag equation and kinetic-energy relation.
source.derivation: Evaluate terminal descent speed from sqrt(2*m*g/(rho*Cd*A)), then compute 0.5*m*v² and convert joules to foot-pounds-force using the production presentation conversion.

comparison.decisionRule: Observed rounded landing kinetic energy equals the independently derived terminal-velocity energy reference.

notes: Analytic regression comparison only; not impact testing, injury-risk validation, or flight validation.
